lines: Davison–Hennecart–Schlegel Mejia, 2303.12592v4 (14 February 2024), actual Theorem 1.1 and Section 9.4 Proposition 9.13, gives a universal-enveloping/BPS generalized Kac–Moody framework. A description by unspecified cohomological generator spaces is not the explicit generator multiplicity statement above. The missing step is exactly the degree-zero generator-space calculation in Gösmann's Conjecture 6.1: dimension one on the Definition 3.1 degrees, zero otherwise. The retrieved v4 has not been established as the latest version; no claim to have cleared its later revisions or a published counterpart.
Harrington/Koley search leads likewise received no mathematical investment.

| Ezerman–Meyer–Solé, *Polynomial Pairs of Integers* (2015), VOL18/Ezerman/eze3.pdf | Conjecture 4: if AB=C and A*B*=C*, with neither A nor B a decimal palindrome, then multiplication is carry-free, equivalently P(A,X)P(B,X)=P(AB,X). Proposition 1 proves that equivalence, not C4. Conjecture 11 is the same-family reverse-product specialization, not extra breadth. Provisional survivor. Current arXiv title/phrase follow-up returns the 2014 v2 precursor plus unrelated word papers; no completeness claimed. |
